title: Language & Terminology Support
description: Support students whose primary barrier is academic language and domain vocabulary.

actions.label: Glossary of Key Terms
actions.description: Provide a structured glossary with definitions, examples, and diagrams for 10–15 key domain terms.

actions.label: Vocabulary Practice
actions.description: Matching and gap-fill exercises using domain vocabulary in context.

actions.label: Bilingual/Simplified Summary
actions.description: Offer a simplified English or mother-tongue summary of the core lecture content.

actions.label: Peer Explanation
actions.description: Pair the student with a peer to explain the concept in their own words (teach-back).
